page0.text:
The next thing I know, it's noon.
"It would seem to be lunchtime, Shirou."
"Yeah, it is."
Both our stomachs growl in agreement.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-18:page0:1

page1.text:
"Let's eat. Is there anything you'd like to eat, Saber?"
"Not in particular. I have been satisfied with each meal you have prepared thus far."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-18:page1:1

page2.text:
Saber puts it kind of oddly.
...Well, at least she's not picky like Tohsaka.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-18:page2:1

page3.text:
"I'll go do a bit of shopping. I'll probably come back the same time as yesterday, so rest in the living room until then."
"Yes. I will be waiting, Shirou."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-18:page3:1

page4.text:
I decide to try making shrimp balls for lunch; I've always wanted to try making them at home.
They'll be piping hot balls of ground shrimp, a bit bigger than takoyaki.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-18:page4:1

page5.text:
"...I bought some mustard and I'm all set with the snacks for our three o'clock snack time."
I load my purchases onto my bike.
That reminds me.
I met Illya here yesterday.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-18:page5:1

page6.text:
"She's not here today."
Well, she probably shouldn't be coming here every day. Somehow, not seeing her is disappointing though.
I haven't told Saber or Tohsaka about meeting Illya yesterday.
She didn't confront me as an enemy...and I'm hesitant to tell them about her in the first place.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-18:page6:1
